calls.statement:
SELECT 
  dp.sku,
  dp.product_name,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) AS total_units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 102
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY dp.sku, dp.product_name
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_sales_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.product_key) as unique_products,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_units,
  MIN(fsl.sale_date) as first_sale_date,
  MAX(fsl.sale_date) as last_sale_date
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 102
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ds.store_key,
  COUNT(*) as sales_line_count,
  SUM(fsl.quantity) as total_quantity
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_store ds ON fsl.store_key = ds.store_key
WHERE ds.store_id = 102
  AND fsl.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND fsl.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY ds.store_key
